event: Schneider Electric Marathon de Paris, 12 April 2026 (annual race)
source: RDD reconstruction of the annual 2026 statutory street itinerary using OpenStreetMap geographic nodes, via Geofabrik
attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors; Geofabrik extract; original street-itinerary selection by Race Day Dreams

factualSources.description: Police order 2026-00388, 3 April 2026: articles 16,18–20,22 ordered race streets; articles 9–11 start/finish restrictions. Legislative/regulatory factual street names, not copied cartographic artwork.

ASO 2026 runner guide: factual start near Rue de Marignan and finish near Rue Spontini on Avenue Foch; corroboration of named course corridors only. No map pixels, traced stroke, logos or artwork redistributed.
Organiser 6 February 2026 announcement identifies the edition and landmarks.

licenceAssessment: Only OSM node coordinates, way identities/versions and relevant tags are adapted from the publicly offered Geofabrik ODbL extract. The retained coordinate database/evidence and derived drawing remain ODbL-1.0; application wrapper is MIT. Regulatory street itinerary is factual. No organiser map artwork/stroke, private GPX, proprietary tiles, elevation or third-party implementation is copied. Full ODbL, attribution and source-data offer are bundled. Ontempo ODbL data were investigated but not incorporated because their unversioned local coordinate frame/edition could not be independently established.
simplification: All selected OSM node positions retained in course order; no interpolated/digitised geographic positions. Ordered actual-street reconstruction including Opéra loop, Nation, Château/Bois de Vincennes, Seine/Tuileries tunnel, Exelmans, Auteuil, Trocadéro, Hubert Germain and Avenue Foch. Road/pedestrian centreline and junction-lane choices are approximate: not the certified racing line, not navigation. Source line about43.21km; distinct42195m marathon-equivalent axis. Start/finish use existing OSM nodes near the published junctions. No elevation/timestamps. Uniform north-up projection, no runtime map request.
